Name: Rire Sprite and Portraits
Author: BubblegumMurderer
Description:
A mod that replaces the sprite and portrait of Elliot to look like Rire from Boyfriend to Death. This mod i'm not 101% sure is all in order, but it should all be there, feel free to tell me if it's not.

Rire and header art belongs to Darqx, http://darqx.tumblr.com/.

Downloads.Description: All the files, put the .XNB files in each folder based on the file name where the .XNB is located. EDIT: Fixed stray purple pixel!
